title: Videos folder
whyItMatters: Recordings and clips saved by the person, plus exports from editors. Names, dates and sizes show what was recorded and when, which is often more telling than the files themselves.
source: Windows known folder Videos, default path under the user profile: https://support.microsoft.com/windows
notes: Known Folder Move does not redirect Videos, so this is normally the real folder. Screen recordings from games and meeting apps are often saved here.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy what you want to keep to an external drive or your cloud account before deleting anything in this folder.
steps: Open the folder named in the plan and look through it before deleting anything.
Check for the same files in OneDrive if the folder looks empty, because Known Folder Move can redirect it.
Copy what you keep to a drive you are taking with you, then delete the rest.
cleanup.risk: Recordings deleted here are gone unless you copied them out first, and large files rarely survive in a cloud account by accident.
cleanup.source: Microsoft Support, Free up drive space in Windows: https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/storage-filemanagement/free-up-drive-space-in-windows
